Grade: PP1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Worship
Topic 2.1: Places of Worship

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Places of Worship, part of Worship in PP1 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Where do we go to pray?
